to: David A. Ramos, MD, founder, contact form: https://www.rfamilymedicalgroup.com/contact-us.html
subject: A link from your Medical Weight Loss page
body:
Hi Dr. Ramos,

Several of your providers receive our referral newsletter, so R Family Medical Group already knows us. Your Medical Weight Loss page describes the weekly monitoring visits, and those are the patients we support on the behavioral side: how to eat, cook and move differently so the weight stays off.

Your site does not have a resources or links page, so I would suggest the Medical Weight Loss page itself, https://www.rfamilymedicalgroup.com/medical-weight-loss.html, or the Patient Education page if you plan to build it out. The page we suggest linking to is our nutritional counseling page, https://www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com/nutritional-counseling-in-san-antonio-tx/, with the link text "Nutritional counseling in San Antonio, Bariatric Counseling Center".

The program is in network with most health insurance plans under patients' mental health benefits, and we send referring providers a summary of behavioral progress at discharge.

In return we will list R Family Medical Group as a referral partner on our website.

Todd McCord
Bariatric Counseling Center, San Antonio
www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com
